knowledge_gaps: The proposed weights increase monotonically with hardness; they do not preferentially emphasize moderately challenging negatives or suppress extreme ones. The report should align its mechanism claims with this formula.

Aggregate pressure can be characterized more precisely: because weights increase with score difference, the weighted exponential sum is at least its uniform counterpart for identical logits. With weights detached, this also increases total negative logit-gradient mass, except in equality cases. Parameter-gradient norms need separate measurement.

The supplied baseline objective, candidate eligibility, replacement policy, target reduction and checkpoint-selection rules remain unspecified. These require host-baseline information; literature searches cannot establish them. The pseudocode is consequently an integration sketch rather than a reproducible executable trial.

The existing consumed-record audit checks CE/BPR reductions. Weighted-loss verification must additionally retain alpha and same-forward logits, reconstruct detached weights, and check the actual weighted reduction. Preserving the old audit unchanged would leave the intervention unverified.

Uniform versus scheduled weighting identifies the combined intervention. An immediate-weighting comparison also changes cumulative weighting exposure, so it cannot isolate timing alone. Predeclare comparisons, diagnostic sampling frequency, complete four-category runtime estimates and the remaining budget.

Originality 3 is plausible, but comparison with self-adversarial negative weighting is missing. Difficulty 3 describes the loss function more accurately than the full integration. Potential 7 remains speculative without measured validation gains or evidence connecting weighting to the reported usefulness failures.

Validation uncertainty and adaptive checkpoint selection need explicit treatment. Training conflicts cannot establish false negatives, and repeated selection on the same 800 validation users can favor noise. Report every inspected configuration and distinguish sampled-validation gains from full-catalog usefulness.
